name: Bhutan Add-On Tour from Kathmandu
sub_region: Paro, Thimphu and Punakha Dzongkhags, Bhutan

difficulty.notes: Cultural touring by private vehicle; the Tiger's Nest (Paro Taktsang) hike is moderate, ~600 m ascent, 2-3 h up.

duration_days.notes: 5 days covers Paro, Thimphu, Punakha (via Dochula) and Tiger's Nest; 6-7 days adds an extra Paro day (Chele La, Kyichu Lhakhang) or Bumthang.

max_altitude_point: Paro Taktsang (Tiger's Nest) - or Dochula Pass ~3,100 m

itinerary.route: Kathmandu - Paro (flight ~1 h-1 h 20 min) - Thimphu (drive ~1-1.5 h)
itinerary.notes: Left-side window seats on KTM-Paro flights may give Everest views on clear days.

itinerary.route: Thimphu sightseeing (Buddha Dordenma, National Memorial Chorten, Tashichho Dzong) - Dochula Pass (108 chortens) - Punakha
Punakha Dzong, suspension bridge, Chimi Lhakhang - drive to Paro
Hike to Paro Taktsang (Tiger's Nest); Rinpung Dzong / National Museum

best_seasons.notes: General operator guidance; check festival (tshechu) dates for Paro/Thimphu.

permits.name: Bhutan Sustainable Development Fee (SDF)
permits.fee: USD 100 per person per night (50% incentive rate, valid until 31 August 2027; standard rate USD 200); children 6-11 pay 50%; under 6 exempt
permits.applies_to: all international visitors except Indian nationals (INR/BTN 1,200 per night) and Bangladeshi quota (USD 15)

permits.name: Bhutan tourist visa application fee
permits.applies_to: all foreign nationals except Indians (entry permit)

guide_requirements: A licensed Bhutanese guide is mandatory for all trekking and for any travel beyond Thimphu and Paro (and when leaving border towns after land entry). Booking via a Bhutanese operator is no longer legally required but OutdoorKing would partner with a licensed in-country operator. Visa must be approved before flight tickets to Bhutan can be bought.

flights: Drukair KB401 Kathmandu-Paro / KB400 Paro-Kathmandu (daily per 2026 schedules; times vary by month)
logistics.notes: SDF and visa fee are paid during the online visa application; SDF is refundable on cancellation (bank charges deducted).

highlights: Paro Taktsang (Tiger's Nest) monastery on a cliff above Paro valley
Punakha Dzong at the confluence of the Pho Chhu and Mo Chhu
Dochula Pass with 108 memorial chortens and Himalayan views
Thimphu: Buddha Dordenma, Tashichho Dzong, National Memorial Chorten
Scenic Kathmandu-Paro flight along the Himalaya
risks: Paro airport flights are weather-sensitive (daylight/visual operations)
Tiger's Nest hike at ~3,000 m can be tiring

acclimatization.notes: Overnights are below ~2,400 m; no formal acclimatization needed.

unverified: Exact Drukair/Bhutan Airlines times and frequencies change monthly; Bhutan Airlines frequency (4x weekly) is from travel sites only.
Tiger's Nest altitude 3,120 m and Dochula 3,100 m are from operator sites.
Child SDF age band wording differs slightly (6-11 vs 6-12) across sources; official FAQ says from age 6 until not yet 12.
